class.name: AbilityData
class.brief_description: A configuration resource that defines the static properties, costs, cooldowns, and tag requirements of a gameplay ability.
class.description: [AbilityData] is a data resource used to configure and define individual skills or spells before they are instantiated. It acts as a template, holding configuration parameters like resource [member cost], [member cooldown] timers, associated [EffectData] elements, and gameplay tags that dictate when and how the ability can be cast.

method.name: get_ability_id
method.description: Returns the unique numerical ID assigned to this ability configuration.

method.name: set_ability_id
method.description: Sets a unique numerical ID to identify and register this ability configuration within the database.

members.member: The primary identification tag ID assigned to this ability itself.
The [GameplayAbility] script containing the runtime execution logic (such as targets, animations, and behaviors) that this resource configures.
The ability cannot be cast if the executing entity currently possesses any of the gameplay tags listed here.
The required gameplay tags that the executing entity must possess to successfully activate this ability.
A list of gameplay tags that will be blocked or prevented from activating on the entity while this ability is actively running.
The duration in seconds that the entity must wait before this ability can be cast again.
The resource value (ex. Mana, Stamina, or Health) required and consumed upon successfully committing the ability.
The array of [EffectData] resources (buffs, debuffs, or instant modifications) applied to targets when this ability executes.
Gameplay tags granted to the executing entity temporarily while this ability is active.
